measurement_contract.changing_observable_value_rule: maximum absolute candidate value for the case beside the registered absolute and relative bounds

mechanism.named_mechanism: independent process compilation selected a different executable for the acceptance graph; reusing JAX's persistent compilation cache removed the cross-process verdict movement

throughput_cost.denominator: six cases times the sum of batch widths, 30 candidate slices; process startup, scalar references and compilation are included
throughput_cost.qualification: negative cost denotes measured time saved; this cold-driver figure is not steady-state solve-only throughput

measurement_contract.input_identity: fresh host copies with matching dtype, shape and byte SHA-256
measurement_contract.relative_difference_scale: maximum absolute value of repetition 1, floored at float64 tiny
measurement_contract.result_blocking: every repeated solve is blocked before retention
measurement_contract.solve_callable_creation: once per case and batch width
